seoTitle: Free Image Redaction Tool: Blur or Black Out
metaDescription: Draw boxes over names, faces or numbers in an image and fill them black or pixelate. Free, runs in your browser, no upload.
intro: Load an image, drag boxes over anything sensitive, fill them with solid black or pixelation, and export a PNG or JPEG. Metadata is dropped on export.
why:
Screenshots leak things quietly: an email address in a tab, an API key in a terminal, a licence plate behind a car, a name on a letter. Sending a support ticket or a bug report usually means hiding a few details first, and opening a heavy editor for a single black rectangle is overkill.

This tool is a small canvas editor. You mark areas with the mouse or a finger, choose black boxes or pixelation, undo or clear, and export. The result is a flattened image, so the hidden content is not kept in a layer. It runs locally, so the unredacted original never leaves your device while you work.
howTo: Choose an image with the file picker.
Pick the fill, black box or pixelate, and set the pixel block size for pixelation.
Drag on the image to mark each area, using Undo or Clear to fix mistakes.
Export as PNG or JPEG and check the result before sharing.

faq.q: Is pixelation safe for passwords or faces?
faq.a: Not always. Pixelation with small blocks can sometimes be reversed or guessed. Use black boxes for passwords, ID numbers and faces, and keep pixelation for low-risk blurring.

faq.q: Is the original content removed from the exported file?
faq.a: Yes. The export is drawn flat onto a canvas, so covered areas are replaced by black or blocks. The original file on your device is unchanged, so keep or delete it as you prefer.

faq.q: Does the export keep EXIF or GPS data?
faq.a: No. Exported files are created from the canvas and contain no EXIF or GPS data. Use the metadata viewer on the result if you want to confirm.

faq.q: Can I redact a PDF with this?
faq.a: Not directly. It works on images only. Convert the PDF pages to images first, redact them, then combine them back into a PDF.
